parameters.query: SELECT s.id::text AS schedule_id,s.content_id,s.version_id::text,s.scheduled_at,s.timezone,c.client_id,c.approval_status,c.approved_version_id::text,v.final_art_path,COALESCE((SELECT config_value::int FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key='schedule_late_tolerance_minutes'),30) AS tolerance_minutes FROM social_media.content_schedule s JOIN social_media.content_items c ON c.content_id=s.content_id LEFT JOIN social_media.content_versions v ON v.id=s.version_id WHERE s.status='SCHEDULED' AND s.scheduled_at<=now() ORDER BY s.scheduled_at FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED;

WITH changed AS (UPDATE social_media.content_schedule SET status=$2,failure_reason=$3,updated_at=now(),metadata=metadata||$4::jsonb WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='SCHEDULED' RETURNING *), content_changed AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items c SET status=$2,updated_at=now() FROM changed s WHERE c.content_id=s.content_id AND c.approved_version_id=s.version_id RETURNING c.content_id), history AS (INSERT INTO social_media.schedule_history(schedule_id,content_id,version_id,action,old_scheduled_at,new_scheduled_at,old_status,new_status,reason,details) SELECT id,content_id,version_id,$2,scheduled_at,scheduled_at,'SCHEDULED',$2,$3,$4::jsonb FROM changed RETURNING history_id), audit AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,severity,details) SELECT client_id,content_id,CASE WHEN $2='READY_TO_PUBLISH' THEN 'CONTENT_READY_TO_PUBLISH' WHEN $2='MISSED' THEN 'SCHEDULE_MISSED' ELSE 'SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_FAILED' END,'07.1 - Worker Recorrente da Agenda',CASE WHEN $2='READY_TO_PUBLISH' THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'WARN' END,jsonb_build_object('schedule_id',id,'version_id',version_id,'scheduled_at',scheduled_at,'status',$2,'reason',$3,'validation',$4::jsonb) FROM changed RETURNING event_id) SELECT id::text AS schedule_id,content_id,version_id::text,scheduled_at,status,failure_reason,(SELECT history_id FROM history) AS history_id,(SELECT event_id FROM audit) AS event_id FROM changed;
